name: Vedanta Society of Iowa
reason: Site looks abandoned and compromised: vedantaiowa.org is a 2013 Joomla site whose homepage carries injected spam links (Swedish and French Viagra/sildenafil sellers), a Google Plus link and a 2021-22 calendar as its newest item; no current programme, and no sign the society is active. Images sit under /vedanta/images/ on a site whose robots.txt has Joomla's standard Disallow rules. Not researched further.
